explication: YumaPlayer is an Android music client combining YouTube Music discovery and library features, Spotify recommendations and imports, local playback, and lossless FLAC streaming. The main user flow is discovery or library selection, then queueing and playback, with synchronized lyrics and audio controls available alongside playback. Additional product branches include music recognition, casting, downloads and cache management, and artwork-driven theming. Relationships are grounded in the README and the supplied source index; unsampled subsystem details are represented only at the directory level.
